name: Bova's Bakery
address: 425 SW Kestor Dr, Port St. Lucie, FL 34953
email_source: Indexed publicly on poyst.com business listing (search-engine snapshot; direct fetch of poyst.com blocked by 429/Cloudflare rate limit during research, so treat as probable but not directly re-verified on-page)
ig_note: IG direct research (bio/links/follower scrape) came back degraded: Railway photo service returned only photo URLs (no bio access), and this sandbox's egress to instagram.com from Playwright returns ERR_CONNECTION_RESET (no residential IP available here). Photos (12) were still recovered via the Railway service. Contact/rating/review/menu data below was cross-verified through independent public directories instead.
ig_followers_approx: 2,606 (per search-engine indexed IG meta snapshot, not directly re-scraped)
rating_source: RestaurantGuru (restaurantguru.com/Bovas-Bakery-Port-Saint-Lucie), fetched directly 2026-08-01: page states 'Rating: 5/5 (111 reviews on Google)', i.e. RestaurantGuru aggregates/cites Google's own rating and review count. Direct Google Maps place page was not independently reachable in this sandbox to re-verify, so the number is one hop removed from Google itself.
has_own_site_check: bovasbakery.com resolves but is protected by a bot-challenge (sg-captcha) with an empty body; independent web search confirms bovasbakery.com / the 'Bova's Bakery' brand at that name is the UNRELATED 1926 Italian bakery in Boston's North End (bovabakeryboston.net is their real site, 134 Salem St, Boston MA), not the Port St. Lucie business.
bakeryportstlucie.com is a DIFFERENT Port St. Lucie bakery: 'Cakes and Sweets by Maggie', owner Maggie, phone 954-257-8757 -- not Bova's Bakery / Nicole Bova.
Tried bovasbakerypsl.com, bovasbakery.net, bovasbakery.us, bovasbakeryflorida.com, bovasbakeryportstlucie.com: none resolve (curl connect failure on all).
No website link found in any directory listing (Yelp, RestaurantGuru, poyst.com, pickfoodup.com, Eventifai) other than social profiles.
CONCLUSION: no own domain found for this business. Only presence is Instagram, Facebook, Yelp, RestaurantGuru, pickfoodup.com and similar directories.
menu_verified: Self-serve cake pop stand (photographed sign, real price, not from a directory): $4 each OR $10 for 3. Rotating flavors seen on the sign: Vanilla, Chocolate, Key Lime (partially obscured), Lemon Blueberry, Strawberry Shortcake.
Custom cakes: birthday/celebration cakes, themed designs (geode cake mentioned in reviews) -- no public price list found, quoted per order.
Cake pop favors / dessert tables for showers, birthdays, parties -- no public price list.
Chocolate-covered pretzels, rice krispie treats -- mentioned in customer reviews as part of custom orders.
Dietary accommodations mentioned across directory summaries: gluten-free, vegan, nut-free; allergy-conscious for dairy/egg/tree nut/coconut, by request.

reviews_verbatim.author: Holly Cellamare
reviews_verbatim.text: The cake was beautifully designed with incredible attention to detail...not only did the cake look amazing, but it tasted even better!

reviews_verbatim.author: Em
reviews_verbatim.text: Bova's bakery is always improving and creating new and enticing sweets!

reviews_verbatim.author: Alexis Shaw
reviews_verbatim.text: Everything tasted as good as it looked. Very happy with the turnout.

brand_vibe: Candy-colored, pastel bakery-boutique: the real self-serve cart is mint/teal with pink accents and multicolor confetti sprinkle decals; product photography leans bright pastel sprinkles (rainbow nonpareils, caramel drizzle). Light base with raspberry-pink accent + soft mint secondary accent derived directly from the physical cart and product photos.
language_note: IG captions and all review quotes found are in English; Port St. Lucie FL market, English-primary business.

notes: Business is home-based: no public walk-in retail storefront confirmed; the verified address is a residential address where a self-serve, honor-system cake pop cart (with a locked 'PAY HERE' mailbox) sits out front during open hours. This is a real, distinctive, verifiable operational detail (seen directly in photos) used as the site's differentiator instead of inventing a 'shop visit' narrative.
